snippet.title: God of War Sons of Sparta - From Past to Pixel | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Available on PS5® today!
Purchase Now or Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/games/god-of-war-sons-of-sparta/

God of War Sons of Sparta translates the series’ signature kinetic action into 2D for this brand-new retro-inspired action platformer. 

This episode of our behind-the-scenes series explores how the team at Mega Cat Studios combined their genre expertise with deep passion and respect for God of War to create something truly unique for the franchise.
